page_title: TOR 1-0 CRE | Torino v Cremonese 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcus Pedersen (Torino) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+9' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
90+3' The foul by Martin Payero (Cremonese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Livio Marinelli.
90+1' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Kristjan Asllani is replaced by Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino).
90+1' Substitution. Valentino Lazaro did his best and is replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

87' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Emil Audero makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
83' Substitution. Che Adams makes his way off the pitch and Cyril Ngonge (Torino) comes on as his replacement.
78' The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
78' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cremonese.
77' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Federico Bonazzoli will be replaced by Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese).
77' The substitution has been made. Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) has replaced Jari Vandeputte.
74' Now Torino have a corner.
73' The foul by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) was seen by Livio Marinelli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
73' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

69' Che Adams (Torino) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Emil Audero.
68' Saul Coco (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Cremonese will take a corner kick.
63' It will be a substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Duvan Zapata walks off.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) is replacing Gvidas Gineitis.
63' Tommaso Barbieri will be replaced by Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
63' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) replacing Giuseppe Pezzella.
62' Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' The ball is cleared after Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but Alberto Paleari comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

57' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Corner kick. Cremonese will have an opportunity.
56' The Cremonese players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
53' Torino are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a throw-in.
53' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
51' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Warren Bondo as he is replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese).
50' Corner kick. Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is ready to send the ball into the box.
49' Che Adams (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Torino have a corner.
49' Neat passing move from Cremonese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
47' Torino are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. It's a throw-in for Cremonese.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
40' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Livio Marinelli shows the yellow card to Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) for a heavy challenge.
36' Livio Marinelli interrupts the game. One of the players from Torino won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
34' Cremonese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
30' The ball is out of play. Cremonese win a corner kick.

30' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alberto Paleari with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Cremonese.

27' 1 - 0 Goal! Duvan Zapata plays in Nikola Vlasic (Torino), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 1:0.
25' The corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is intercepted by the defence.
25' Duvan Zapata (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
24' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
22' Che Adams (Torino) tries to find Duvan Zapata, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
20' Torino earn a corner.
15' A pass by Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

14' Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
14' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

13' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Cremonese are going to take it.
12' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
11' The Cremonese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
8' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) jumps into a tackle and Livio Marinelli signals a foul.
8' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Torino.
3' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
3' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Cremonese are awarded a free kick.

1' Saul Coco (Torino) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Livio Marinelli with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli was nominated as the referee for this game.
